Layer C · Market regime — is it supportive?

Market: Confirmed Uptrend — 🟢 CONFIRMED UPTREND (since 2026-10-16, Nifty -1.99%)
Liquid new 52-week highs per session, last 30: latest 0, range 0–58 · Nifty 50 over 20 sessions to 23 Oct: -2.2% · Top sectors by new highs (group-name prefix): Chemicals 7, Computer 7, Retail 7, Food 6, Leisure 5
⚠️ Defensive groups among the leaders (1): Food-Packaged — O'Neil: buying in gold, food, grocery, tobacco and utilities after a couple of bull-market years can flag a top.
Method. Minervini, Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard ch. 6: "How do you find which groups are leading? Follow the individual stocks. I like to track the 52-week new high list. The industry groups with a healthy number of stocks hitting new highs early in a bull market will often be the leaders … the best stocks in the leading groups advance before it's obvious that the group or sector is hot." Built to the Bottom-Up Group Detection Improvement Spec (2026-09-13): three separate layers, never blended — C market regime (above), A group leadership (the tables: new-high counts over 5, 10 and 20 sessions, breadth, 5-day acceleration, near-high bands, RS80/RS90 breadth, relative resilience vs the Nifty, leader health → a lifecycle state), B stock evidence (open a group: RS order, distance to high, excess return, earnings and sales, ch. 7 labels). A new high = the day's high equals the 252-session high. Adaptive count: 5–14 liquid members need 3 new highs, 15–29 need 4, ≥ 30 need 5. NH10 trend reads the 10-session count 15, 10 and 5 sessions ago and now — "3→5→9→14" matters more than "15→15→15→15". Not obvious yet = MSI's rank is worse than 40.
O'Neil checks, shown as warnings, never filters: bottom-20 rank (he never owns these; when the stocks point there anyway, treat it with care); Leading also needs ≥ 2 members with RS ≥ 80 — strength confirmed by another important stock; defensive groups leading after a bull run can flag a top; ◆ RS line at a 52-week high — his Centex case, where the RS line led the price by three months ("leads price" = RS line at a new high while the price is still over 5% below its own). Cyclical (Minervini): steel, metals, autos, chemicals, paper, oil & gas, building materials — read them on the cycle; a low P/E after record earnings is late, not cheap.
⚠️ Every threshold is a stand-in from the spec, not validated on NSE; the spec's priority 7 — a threshold backtest — is the next step. Group-name prefixes stand in for IBD's broad sectors. Funds/ETFs excluded (Finance-Etf / Etn, Finance-Publ Inv Fd-Bal). Resilience uses the Nifty 50 to 23 Oct 2026.
Layer A2 · Group index plots — MarketSmith's own group index charts (the top 60 groups by MSI rank), bars to 22 Oct 2026 (MarketSmith's group feed runs a session behind the stock data).
A group index at a new high is the top-down view; the stock counts beside it are the bottom-up view. They often disagree — stocks lead, the group index lags — so read them together. A group outside the top 60 by rank is not in this table.
